bubbles.title: Report done-but-open tracks
bubbles.hint: GROUND RULE (whole command): review is REPORT ONLY. It never closes, deletes or changes any track. The human decides. — list tracks where every bubble is done but the track isn't closed

bubbles.title: Report broken links
bubbles.hint: fork, sides, origin or parent pointing at a track that's missing or closed

bubbles.title: Exit code on findings
bubbles.hint: like show's exit 3: 0 = clean, a distinct non-zero code when there are findings, so hooks/CI can nag
undecided: staleness signal (file mtime vs a new updatedAt field) and stale-hint detection (paths in hints that no longer exist)
